result.instructions: Tools for Dropcontact, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Find the professional email and company details for Marie Dupont at Dropcontact."; "Enrich this list of 50 contacts from my CSV and give me the emails that were found."; "How many Dropcontact credits do I have left?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Dropcontact data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run dropcontact_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run dropcontact_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run dropcontact_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. dropcontact_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: dropcontact_get_credits
tools.title: Get remaining credits
tools.description: Return the credits left on the Dropcontact account. Free for you: it does not use credits. Dropcontact API: GET /v1/account/credits.

tools.name: dropcontact_submit_enrichment
tools.title: Submit contacts for enrichment
tools.description: Start B2B enrichment for 1 to 250 contacts: finds and verifies professional emails, LinkedIn and company data. Returns a request_id; fetch the records with dropcontact_get_enrichment_result (usually 10-60 seconds). Pay on success: a credit is used only when an email is found (1 credit per email verification you request). A batch with too few credits for all its records is refused with HTTP 403. Dropcontact API: POST /v1/enrich/all.

full_name.description: Contact full name, when first and last name are not separate.

civility.description: Contact civility, e.g. Mr or Mrs.

email.description: Contact email. Dropcontact verifies and qualifies it (1 credit, even when another email is found).

job_function.description: Contact job function (broad category of the role).

job_level.description: Contact seniority level, e.g. manager or executive.

custom_fields.description: Your own fields. Returned as-is in the result. Counts toward the 15 kB record limit.

data.description: The contacts to enrich: 1 to 250 records. Each record is one person (and optionally their company).

siren.description: Add the French company SIREN and SIRET numbers to each result. Default false.

language.description: Language of the email qualification labels. Default fr; any other value gives en.

tools.name: dropcontact_get_enrichment_result
tools.title: Get enrichment result
tools.description: Fetch the enriched records for a request_id from dropcontact_submit_enrichment. If the batch is still running, the result says ready:false with the reason; call again after about 30 seconds. Set force_results to get the records already enriched while the batch is still running. Free: it does not use credits. Dropcontact API: GET /v1/enrich/all/{request_id}.

force_results.description: Return the records already enriched instead of waiting for the whole batch. Adds a status field (ready or in_progress).

tools.name: dropcontact_get_webhook
tools.title: Get default webhook URL
tools.description: Return the default webhook URL that Dropcontact calls when an enrichment result is ready (null when none is set). Dropcontact API: GET /v1/enrich/webhook.
